title: A harmonic Maxwell mode gives an exact resonance obstruction to bounded cubic cancellation of lifted-current work

resonance.free_orbit: Linearize at vacuum on R x T3. Choose Qv_q=qv_q, phi_q=a cos(omega_q(k)t) exp(ik dot x)v_q, k nonzero, and a constant harmonic electric field E_h with E_h dot k nonzero
resonance.gauss: The linear Gauss constraint holds because Im<Q phi,partial_t phi>=0 and div E_h=0
resonance.time_average: The K1413 lifted work has average (e Vol/2) q^(2n+1) a^2 (E_h dot k), which is nonzero
resonance.bounded_normal_form_obstruction: The time derivative of a bounded autonomous cubic functional has zero average on this periodic free orbit, so it cannot cancel the lifted-current work
resonance.maxwell_energy_composition: Adding c times the single Maxwell energy cancels a charge-q lifted current only for c=q^(2n). The realized charges q=4 and q=8 require incompatible c for n>=1
resonance.scope: The obstruction binds the sector retaining K1397's harmonic Maxwell mode. A strict zero-harmonic sector removes this witness and leaves nonzero-mode null-form and small-divisor routes open
